text: Software Engineering is a discipline that applies systematic, standardized, and measurable engineering methods to the development, operation, and maintenance of software. It integrates knowledge from various fields such as computer science, mathematics, and project management, aiming to address core issues such as complexity, reliability, and maintainability of large-scale software systems, and ensure that software products are efficient and of high quality to meet user needs. Unlike simple "programming", software engineering places greater emphasis on "engineering thinking" - the entire process management from requirements analysis to final delivery, which is the core discipline for building various software systems (such as operating systems, mobile applications, enterprise-level platforms).
